title: Corsair's Nebula
synopsis: Taking refuge inside the lawless Asteroid Belt Syndicates of Ostra-9, Leo Mercer proves his analog flight instincts in deadly close-quarters dogfights among spinning mega-asteroids. As his romantic bond with Captain Astrid 'Vex' Ross deepens into fierce loyalty, they discover an encrypted Golden Age military beacon pulsing from the heart of an ionized plasma nebula.

chapters.title: The Ghost of Ostra-9
chapters.summary: Docking the battered Starlight Marauder inside the cavernous hollowed-out pirate asteroid.

chapters.title: Bounty on an Ancient Ghost
chapters.summary: Word leaks of a living pre-collapse pilot; syndicates and bounty hunters prowl the pressurized bazaars.

chapters.title: Neon and Kinetic Fire
chapters.summary: A shootout through the hydroponics bay and mag-train tunnels; Astrid and Leo fight back-to-back.

chapters.title: The Scrap Market Barter
chapters.summary: Leo helps Orlo retrofit the Marauder using archaic propulsion bypasses; friction turns into mutual respect.

chapters.title: A Drink in the Smuggler's Ring
chapters.summary: Astrid and Leo share a rare quiet moment at an orbital speakeasy; simmering romantic vulnerability.

chapters.title: Shadows of the Syndicate
chapters.summary: The Syndicate Boss Demetrius demands Leo as payment for docking rights; Astrid refuses with drawn steel.

chapters.title: The Hangar Bay Escape
chapters.summary: A daring midnight breakout; Leo manually pilots the Marauder through narrow asteroid docking tubes under fire.

chapters.title: Into the Ion Veil
chapters.summary: Fleeing into the blinding electromagnetic storms of the Veil Nebula; radiation screens humming.

chapters.title: The Thermal Ambush
chapters.summary: Two corsair wolf-pack interceptors attack from radar shadows; vacuum railgun duel.

chapters.title: Manual Override
chapters.summary: When automated targeting fails in the ion storm, Leo uses analog drift optics to score two direct hits.

chapters.title: The Wreckage of Valkyrie
chapters.summary: Discovering a derelict pre-collapse military dreadnought drifting inside the nebula.

chapters.title: Boarding the Ghost Fleet
chapters.summary: Spacewalk across the silent void into the derelict's shattered spine; zero-G exploration.

chapters.title: The Sealed Command Vault
chapters.summary: Leo uses his thumbprint and DNA to open the command vault; ancient emergency beacons flare.

chapters.title: Whispers from the Golden Age
chapters.summary: Decrypting the dreadnought's black box log; chilling hints about why Sol was quarantined.

chapters.title: Breached Containment
chapters.summary: An unstable micro-fusion core begins a prompt-critical runaway; harrowing race back to the airlock.

chapters.title: Bruises and Starlight
chapters.summary: Astrid bandages Leo's burns in her cabin; intense physical proximity breaks their emotional barriers.

chapters.title: The First Touch
chapters.summary: A quiet, breathless night in the captain's quarters; confessing what they mean to each other under the nebula's glow.

chapters.title: The Picket Hunter Arrives
chapters.summary: A Dominion stealth frigate tracks the dreadnought's beacon; torpedoes in the dark.

chapters.title: The Nebula Slingshot
chapters.summary: Using a protostar's gravity well to sling the Marauder past the hunter's firing arc.

chapters.title: The Beacon's Promise
chapters.summary: Transmitting the coordinates of the Star-Eater Nebula; setting course for the unknown.
